data.one_liner: Modular hierarchical logging engine for Dart and Flutter with background pipelines.
data.what_it_does: logd provides structured, hierarchical logging for Dart and Flutter applications. It features modular pipeline processing, ambient context propagation, O(1) configuration resolution, and support for offloading I/O to background isolates.
use_when: You need hierarchical, dot-separated loggers with parent-child configuration inheritance.
You want to offload formatting and disk or network I/O to background isolates to prevent UI hitching.
You need ambient structured context propagation across async boundaries without boilerplate parameter threading.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, single-file print wrapper with no requirements for structure or performance.
Your project avoids extra dependencies and can rely solely on standard print or basic packages.
strengths: Background isolate offloading for sinks prevents blocking the UI thread.
Ambient structured context (MDC) flows automatically through microtasks and async boundaries.
weaknesses: Requires learning its custom pipeline and handler configuration model.
Advanced output features rely on separate satellite packages (e.g., logd_dio, logd_sqlite).
